title: Bureau Banners
description: Wear any banner on your player's head.
body:
# Bureau Banners
Makes all banners wearable, no config required.

## Installation
1. Navigate to your world folder
2. Place the `.zip` file in the `datapacks` folder

## Additional Notes
I mostly made this for use on my own server, but I figured that there was someone else out there who might benefit from me publishing it.

Thank you!
